notes.title: Dev Update - 5/9
notes.notes:
Hello Legends! 🧙🏼‍♂️

We are here today with a long awaited update video. We are announcing our next playtest for the game!

In the video we talk about changes we've made in the game, the future direction of the game, and QOL changes that a lot of players have been asking for!

We're grateful for the feedback and hope to see you during our next playtest starting on May 10th. See you at the tables!

[previewyoutube=tY5Hn5VLuCE;full][/previewyoutube]
